page.overview:
Who is Feudal Foot Ninja?

Feudal Foot Ninja are enemies in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus. They make a cameo appearance in a bonus video regarding the Sword of Tengu in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3: Mutant Nightmare.

Appearing in the Feudal Japan area, they appear in a variety of variations similar to the present day , wielding katanas, bō, or bow and arrows—using either regular arrows, fire arrows, or sleeping gas arrows—but while they use the same attacks as the modern day Foot Ninja, these ninjas have slightly more health, both the katana and bō wielders are capable of stunning the player with a few of their attacks, and can inflict a bit more damage.

In addition, there are also Feudal versions of , which never appeared in the show itself; they are actually encountered before modern day Large Foot Ninja, and are slightly weaker than them as a result. In both the Foot Fight and Battle Nexus tournaments, multiple Feudal Foot Captains, who behave very similar to , can be fought (the latter tournament has a small group helping the ) and are among some of the most dangerous enemies in the game.

Appearing in Level 4, within stages 1 and 3. Feudal Foot Ninja wield katana and can run at great speeds. They appear in hallways through trap doors or walls, and attack in two varieties depending on their color. Feudal Foot Ninjas with red headbands will strike with a spinning jump slice, whereas ones with blue headbands will strike with a frontal katana strike and can backflip if a Turtle is too close to one. Within certain halls appears a ninja with a twin-bladed sword similar to from the GBA version of the first game. This variant approaches slowly, can withstand more punishment than a regular Feudal Foot Ninja, and can throw their sword in a large horizontally spinning long range blade attack. A red tinted variant of this type of ninja guards a key in Stage 3 leading to another key that leads to the exit. All Feudal Foot Ninjas that can't find a hiding out Turtle will eventually disappear from battle by use of smoke bombs. Hitting a ninja right as he uses a smoke bomb will cause a visual glitch where his sprite blinks rapidly.
